about_the_game:
An Incremental Escape from an Icy Prison

Play as a demon trying to smash his way through the icy barriers of a deep, frozen cavern. Wield your pickaxe and hellfire to shatter the ice - it's the only way to forge a path to the surface. A demonic magic crystal will grant you the power to upgrade your abilities and make your escape ever more efficient.

More Than Just Barriers

As you make your escape, you'll encounter and destroy not only obstacles but also intricate ice formations depicting mysterious scenes. Who are the figures in these frozen dioramas, and what do they signify? What are the cryptic messages you keep receiving? Why are you trapped here, and who left you the pickaxe? These are the questions you must answer as you piece together the truth.

No Cruelty

Though you play as a demon, you won't be harming any living creatures in this game. Your only adversaries are the thick layers of ice and the statues frozen within. Even if you wanted to, you couldn't - you are utterly alone in this profound confinement.

Procedural Generation & The "Endless Escape" Mode

After completing the main story (averaging about 2 hours), you will unlock the "Endless Escape" mode. Here, you can attempt to break free again and again, with the cavern being procedurally generated for each new run. In this mode, your speed and efficiency are key. Manage your upgrades and actions wisely to climb the ranks. Only the fastest and most resourceful demons will earn a spot on the Steam leaderboards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (latest Service Pack)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Phenom™ X3 8650
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 600 series, AMD Radeon™ HD 7000 series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A small incremental game with a mischievous story. You're a demon trapped in ice. Your only tools are a weak pickaxe and a pathetic fire spell. Use a magic crystal to upgrade them to absurd power levels and break free, all while finding messages from an old... 'friend'.
